status: Empty. No authorized first-party report has been imported, so there is nothing to report.
rule: A row is added only from an authorized first-party report, for example an Associates report exported by the account owner. Every row carries the date it was imported, the period it covers, the report it came from, and the file or URL kept with it. Nothing is estimated, scraped or modelled. No conversion score or revenue forecast is presented anywhere on this site.

columns.name: timestamp_imported
columns.meaning: When the row was added, in UTC.

columns.name: report_date_range
columns.meaning: The period the source report covers.

columns.name: source
columns.meaning: Name of the authorized first-party report or export.

columns.name: provenance
columns.meaning: File name or URL of the report, kept alongside the row.

columns.name: channel
columns.meaning: The site section or tracking ID the figures belong to, for example shopnow047c-20.

columns.name: eligible_sessions
columns.meaning: Sessions reported as eligible in the source. Blank if the report does not state it.

columns.name: clicks
columns.meaning: Clicks as reported in the source. Blank if the report does not state it.

columns.name: reported_orders
columns.meaning: Orders as reported in the source. Blank if the report does not state it.
